lines.en: label dojo10:
scene namesredux1
I begin to make my way to the dojo because I have lost all control over my life and am slowly falling into the clutches of a rich blonde girl.
lines.zh: 我开始往道场走，因为我已经彻底失去了对人生的掌控，正慢慢落入一个富有的金发女孩的魔掌。

lines.en: But hey, she's cute and she likes me- which is really way more than I should be asking for in the first place.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，她可爱，又喜欢我——这本就比我该奢求的多太多了。

lines.en: So if going along with her weird roleplay stuff is all I have to do to get closer to her, I'm absolutely going to do that.
lines.zh: 所以，只要陪她玩那些怪异的角色扮演就能拉近和她的距离，那我绝对照做。

lines.en: Would she continue falling for me even if I decided to {i}not{/i} do things like that with her? Probably.
lines.zh: 就算我决定{i}不{/i}陪她做那种事，她还会继续爱上我吗？大概会。

lines.en: But I want her to fall faster.
lines.zh: 可我想让她陷得更快一点。

lines.en: And me looking like an idiot is a small price to pay for getting an attractive teenager's pants off.
lines.zh: 而为了把一个迷人的少女的裤子脱下来，我出点洋相也算不上什么代价。

lines.en: scene namesredux2
: Oh, Sensei! What are you up to?
lines.zh: : 哦，Sensei！你这是要去哪儿？

lines.en: Or dress, I suppose.
lines.zh: 或者说，裙子，我想。

lines.en: : I was actually just on my way to the dojo. Are you heading there now?
lines.zh: : 我其实正要去道场。你现在是往那儿去吗？

lines.en: scene namesredux3
: Actually...I'm coming {i}back{/i} from the dojo right now...
lines.zh: : 其实……我是刚从道场{i}回来{/i}……

lines.en: : Don't tell me you actually got kicked out?
lines.zh: : 你该不会真被赶出来了吧？

lines.en: : Was it the giant fan? The guns? Never listening to the instructor? Ordering pizza in the middle of lessons? Riding a-
lines.zh: : 是因为那把大扇子？那些枪？从来不听教练的话？课上到一半叫披萨？骑着——

lines.en: : I get it. I like to have fun.
lines.zh: : 知道了知道了。我就是爱玩嘛。

lines.en: : But no, I wasn't kicked out. The dojo is just closed for the day- which is a real bummer since I was in the mood to actually practice for {i}real{/i} this time.
lines.zh: : 不过没有，我没被赶出来。只是道场今天关门——真是扫兴，因为我这次还真有心情{i}认真{/i}练一练呢。

lines.en: : Yeah, I'm not buying that.
lines.zh: : 是吗，我可不信。

lines.en: scene namesredux4
: I mean it! I was feeling really fired up today!
lines.zh: : 我说真的！我今天状态特别亢奋！

lines.en: : And just so you know, until you started showing up all the time, I really {i}was{/i} giving it my all!
lines.zh: : 而且你搞清楚，在你开始天天出现之前，我{i}真的{/i}是拼尽全力的！

lines.en: : It's just a lot harder to focus on things when you're there. I blame your sweatpants.
lines.zh: : 只是你在的时候，我很难集中注意力。都怪你的运动裤。

lines.en: : My sweatpants?...
lines.zh: : 我的运动裤？……

lines.en: scene namesredux5
: Yeah. Don't you feel the same way about girls in pajamas? Like, they'd just be so easy to just slip off and...
lines.zh: : 对啊。你看到穿睡衣的女孩不也一样吗？就好象，那衣服一脱就下来了，然后……

lines.en: : ...and what?
lines.zh: : ……然后什么？

lines.en: : I can't finish that sentence because there is a woman pushing a stroller behind you and I don't want to taint the poor baby's ears with all of the impure thoughts I have.
lines.zh: : 那句话我说不出口，因为你身后有个推着婴儿车的女人，我可不想用我满脑子的龌龊念头去污染那个可怜宝宝的耳朵。

lines.en: : How are you able to maintain friendships when it seems like the only thing you have on your mind at all times is me?
lines.zh: : 你脑子里好像时时刻刻只有我，这样还怎么维持友谊啊？

lines.en: scene namesredux6
: Mmm...I guess it probably helps that my best friend is the only other person in this city who can compete with me in terms of how much we love you.
lines.zh: : 嗯……大概是因为，我最好的朋友是这座城市里唯一一个能和我比谁更爱你的人吧。

lines.en: : You need new hobbies.
lines.zh: : 你该培养点新爱好了。

lines.en: scene namesredux7
: Sorry, my only other hobby closed down for the day, so you're going to have to deal with me just talking about how much I love you for the rest of the afternoon.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，我唯一的另一个爱好今天关门了，所以接下来这一下午，你只能忍受我不停地说我有多爱你了。

lines.en: : Have I mentioned lately that I love you? Because I love you.
lines.zh: : 我最近有说过我爱你吗？因为我爱你。

lines.en: : I had no idea. You hide it so well.
lines.zh: : 我完全没看出来。你藏得可真深。

lines.en: : Not as well as you hide your freakishly huge penis behind those old sweatpants in karate class.
lines.zh: : 可没有你在空手道课上，用那条旧运动裤把你那根大得离谱的鸡巴藏得那么好。

lines.en: scene namesredux2
: Do you have a bucket of cold water you could dump on my head? That's what Maya always does when I start rambling on about you and I think it would come in handy right now.
lines.zh: : 你有没有一桶冷水能浇在我头上？每次我一唠叨起你，Maya 就总是这么干，我觉得这会儿正好用得上。

lines.en: : I don't, no...
lines.zh: : 没有，我没有……

lines.en: It never ceases to amaze me how open Ayane is about her feelings for me...
lines.zh: Ayane 对我的感情表达得如此坦荡，这一点总让我惊叹不已……

lines.en: I really don’t get it, to be honest.
lines.zh: 说实话，我真的不太懂。

lines.en: I'm not particularly attractive or...interesting...
lines.zh: 我既不怎么有魅力，也不……有趣……

lines.en: I'm not even fun.
lines.zh: 我甚至一点也不好玩。

lines.en: I'm just...there.
lines.zh: 我只是……在那里而已。

lines.en: But...maybe that's exactly {i}why{/i} she likes me?
lines.zh: 但……也许这正是她喜欢我的{i}原因{/i}？

lines.en: Because I'm the only man she's in regular contact with- and one that she's apparently been around for years.
lines.zh: 因为我是她唯一经常接触的男人——而且显然已经相处了好些年。

lines.en: How far back do these feelings go?
lines.zh: 这份感情究竟是从多早开始的？

lines.en: And what sorts of feelings were locked away inside of {i}this{/i} body before I was granted the opportunity to take over?
lines.zh: 而在我得到机会接管之前，这{i}具{/i}身体里又锁着什么样的感情？

lines.en: scene namesredux8
{s}NONE{/s}
lines.zh: {s}NONE{/s}

lines.en: scene namesredux2
: Well anyway, since we can’t do anything at the dojo, did you want to hang out around here?
lines.zh: : 总之，既然道场这边没戏了，你要不要在这附近逛逛？

lines.en: scene namesredux9
: Like...around here? But what if people see us?
lines.zh: : 就……在这附近？可要是被人看到怎么办？

lines.en: : Weren't you ranting about my penis to a mysterious woman like, thirty seconds ago?
lines.zh: : 你三十秒前不是还对着一个陌生女人大谈我的鸡巴吗？

lines.en: : No, I was ranting about the layer of suspiciously provocative fabric that {i}conceals{/i} your penis. It's totally different.
lines.zh: : 没有，我大谈的是那层{i}遮住{/i}你鸡巴的、可疑地撩人的布料。完全不是一回事。

lines.en: : Either way, it’s not like we’ll be holding hands or making out or anything. It's not a big deal if people see us together in the middle of the day.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，我们又不会牵手或者接吻什么的。大白天被人看到我们在一起也没什么大不了。

lines.en: scene namesredux10
: Darn it...I thought you were asking me on a date for a second.
lines.zh: : 可恶……我刚才有一瞬间还以为你是在约我约会呢。

lines.en: : You can call it a date if you want. I’m just not a fan of the idea of publicly displaying affection.
lines.zh: : 你想叫它约会也行。我只是不太喜欢公开秀恩爱这一套。

lines.en: Let alone publicly displaying affection with a girl young enough to be my daughter.
lines.zh: 更别提是和一个年轻到可以当我女儿的女孩公开秀恩爱了。

lines.en: scene namesredux9
: I figured as much. Even with Ami, you've never really liked showing affection in public. Or...really anything, for that matter.
lines.zh: : 我就知道。就算是和 Ami 在一起，你也从来不太喜欢在公开场合表达感情。或者说……任何形式的表达，说实话。

lines.en: : You know, it's weird. I'm never really a fan of the mysterious type in manga...but with you, I kind of can't really imagine anything else.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，真奇怪。我本来一直不太喜欢漫画里那种神秘型的角色……可换成是你，我反倒想象不出别的样子了。

lines.en: : I'm going to take your undying love for me as an {i}okay{/i} and assume that you're fine with hanging out around here.
lines.zh: : 那我就把你对我至死不渝的爱当成一句{i}好{/i}，当作你愿意在这附近逛逛了。

lines.en: scene namesredux2
: Sensei, you literally never have to ask me if I'm okay with anything. {i}Especially{/i} if that thing is spending time with you.
lines.zh: : Sensei，你真的永远都不用问我愿不愿意。{i}尤其{/i}是当那件事是和你待在一起的时候。

lines.en: : I'm just not really sure what you want to do. I've never gone on a not-date that I'm still allowed to call a date before. Let alone one with my best friend's uncle and teacher.
lines.zh: : 我只是不太确定你想做什么。我从来没经历过一场「不算约会」、却又还能被我叫做约会的约会。更别提是和我最好朋友的叔叔兼老师了。

lines.en: : Then I guess we can just...start off small and go for a walk or...sit on a bench and talk or something? Preferably {i}not{/i} about the type of pants I wear at the dojo.
lines.zh: : 那我们就……从小事开始，去散个步，或者……坐在长椅上聊聊天什么的？最好{i}别{/i}聊我在道场穿的那种裤子。

lines.en: : Good call, Sensei. If there's anything I've learned from my butler, it's that you never want to get horny on a park bench.
lines.zh: : 说得对，Sensei。我从管家身上学到的一件事就是：千万别在公园长椅上发情。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: scene black
: Nothing, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 没什么，Ayane。

lines.en: : Just thinking about how I wound up here.
lines.zh: : 只是在想，我怎么会走到今天这一步。

lines.en: The two of us do a few laps around the block, not straying far at all from where we met up, before taking a seat on a bench near the subway station.
lines.zh: 我们绕着街区走了几圈，一点都没离开相遇的地方太远，然后在地铁站附近的一条长椅上坐了下来。

lines.en: scene ayanestreet1
Ayane moves as close to me as she can without making it look like we're the world's least appropriate couple.
lines.zh: Ayane 尽可能地往我身边靠，又不至于让人觉得我们是全世界最不像话的一对。

lines.en: The chaotic horny energy that was radiating off of her a few minutes ago has since been replaced by an aura of adoration that painfully perforates my nostrils and lures me into a false sense of security.
lines.zh: 几分钟前从她身上散发出的那股混乱的发情气息，此刻已被一种爱慕的光环所取代，那光环刺痛地钻进我的鼻孔，把我引入一种虚假的安全感。

lines.en: I do not feel insecure in believing that this girl will change at the drop of a hat- but in the fact that inching closer to comfort somehow makes me less comfortable than anything else I can think of.
lines.zh: 让我不安的并不是「这女孩随时都会变」这一点，而是：越接近舒适，我反而比任何事都更不自在。

lines.en: : So, now what? Want to talk about holding hands since we're not actually allowed to do it?
lines.zh: : 那么，现在聊什么？既然我们其实不能牵手，要不要聊聊牵手？

lines.en: : I can't imagine that conversation topic lasting very long.
lines.zh: : 我想这个话题聊不了多久。

lines.en: : Then pick a better one. You're the leader of this not-date and I'm just a girl who's really thirsty for some good old-fashioned handholding.
lines.zh: : 那你挑个好点的。你是这场「不算约会」的主导，而我只是个极度渴望来点老式牵手的女孩。

lines.en: : Tone it down, Ayane. Who knows what would happen to us if someone overheard you saying something as taboo as {i}that.{/i}
lines.zh: : 收敛点，Ayane。要是有人听到你说了{i}那种{/i}禁忌的话，谁知道我们会出什么事。

lines.en: scene ayanestreet2
: Good point! We should talk about more socially accepted topics like the current political climate or...whether or not pineapple belongs on pizza.
lines.zh: : 有道理！我们该聊些社会更能接受的话题，比如当下的政治气候，或者……菠萝该不该放在披萨上。

lines.en: : It doesn't.
lines.zh: : 不该。

lines.en: : Well, of course {i}I{/i} know that and {i}you{/i} know that, but there could be people who don't know any better walking past us and it's up to us as a responsible not-couple to not offend them.
lines.zh: : 嗯，{i}我{/i}当然知道，{i}你{/i}也当然知道，可说不定有不明就里的人从我们身边走过，作为一对负责任的「不算情侣」，我们有义务不去冒犯他们。

lines.en: : Are you sure you're okay with this, Ayane?
lines.zh: : 你确定这样没关系吗，Ayane？

lines.en: scene ayanestreet3
: Hm? What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 嗯？你什么意思？

lines.en: : I mean, obviously I'm okay hanging out with you like this since I'm the one who asked. But the more you talk, the more I feel like you should be off bantering with someone a little better at bantering back.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，既然是我开的口，我当然乐意和你这样相处。可你越说，我就越觉得你该去找个更擅长回嘴的人斗嘴。

lines.en: : But I don't want to banter with anybody else. If I did, I wouldn't have agreed to not-date you today.
lines.zh: : 可我不想跟别人斗嘴。要是想的话，我今天就不会答应「不算约会」地约你了。

lines.en: : I guess I just don't want the not-date to be too boring for you.
lines.zh: : 我想我只是不想让这场「不算约会」对你来说太无聊。

lines.en: That and I'm feeling an overwhelming difficulty being near her without capitalizing on her raging (Yet temporarily dormant) hormones.
lines.zh: 还有就是，我越来越难做到待在她身边，却不去利用她那汹涌（虽然暂时蛰伏）的荷尔蒙。

lines.en: : I'm not bored at all, Sensei. I'm having tons of fun.
lines.zh: : 我一点都不无聊，Sensei。我开心极了。

lines.en: : And it's not like I’ve ever been on a real date before, so there's no bar you need to pass or anything.
lines.zh: : 而且我又从来没有真正约会过，所以你也没有什么门槛需要跨过。

lines.en: scene ayanestreet4
: Really? Not even once?
lines.zh: : 真的？一次都没有？

lines.en: : Not even once.
lines.zh: : 一次都没有。

lines.en: : Why not?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Because you never asked me.
lines.zh: : 因为你从来没有约过我。

lines.en: : You make it sound like you've been saving yourself for me or something.
lines.zh: : 听你这口气，好像你一直在为我守身似的。

lines.en: scene ayanestreet5
: You make it sound like that's a bad thing {i}or something.{/i}
lines.zh: : 听你这口气，好像那是件坏事{i}似的{/i}。

lines.en: : I mean, it kind of is. What if nothing ever came of it? Would you have just...gone on forever? Indefinitely waiting for me?
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，那确实有点糟。要是最后什么都没成呢？你就这么……一直下去？无限期地等着我？

lines.en: : Of course not, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 当然不会，Sensei。

lines.en: : That’s a relief. Because for a second I thought-
lines.zh: : 那我就放心了。因为有一瞬间我还以为——

lines.en: scene ayanestreet6
: I made a promise to myself a long time ago...that if you didn’t reciprocate my love by the time I graduate high school...
lines.zh: : 很久以前我对自己许下过一个承诺……如果在高中毕业之前，你还没有回应我的爱……

lines.en: : That I would blow up the city...
lines.zh: : 我就把这座城市炸掉……

lines.en: scene ayanestreet7
scene ayanestreet8
: So, Sensei, when we get married...what are we going to name our kids?
lines.zh: : 那么，Sensei，等我们结婚了……我们的孩子要叫什么名字？

lines.en: : I really like the name Ami, but that one’s kind of already taken, so...
lines.zh: : 我很喜欢 Ami 这个名字，不过这个名字已经被人占了，所以……

lines.en: : Do you think Ami would be okay with changing her name if we asked her really nicely?
lines.zh: : 你觉得，要是我们好好地求她，Ami 会愿意改名字吗？

lines.en: scene ayanestreet9
: Of course, there are also names like Airi or...Ayaka...or Ai...
lines.zh: : 当然，还有 Airi 啊……Ayaka 啊……或者 Ai 啊……

lines.en: : Or maybe Aki if we wind up having a boy first.
lines.zh: : 要是我们先生了个男孩，也许可以叫 Aki。

lines.en: : I like A-Names if you couldn’t tell. Like Ayane!
lines.zh: : 你应该看得出来，我喜欢 A 开头的名字。比如 Ayane！

lines.en: scene ayanestreet8
: I’ve been thinking about it a lot and I’m pretty sure I want seven children if that’s okay with you.
lines.zh: : 我反复想过了，如果可以的话，我很确定我想要七个孩子。

lines.en: : I was actually telling Ami that the other day and-
lines.zh: : 前几天我还跟 Ami 说了这事，然后——

lines.en: scene ayanestreet9
: Oh, sorry. {i}Your{/i} Ami, not {i}our{/i} Ami. Our Ami hasn’t been born yet.
lines.zh: : 哦，抱歉。是{i}你的{/i} Ami，不是{i}我们的{/i} Ami。我们的 Ami 还没出生呢。

lines.en: : Anyway, I was telling her that I want seven kids with you and she was all like ‘What are you planning on doing to my [uncle]!?’
lines.zh: : 总之，我告诉她说我想和你生七个孩子，她的反应是「你到底打算对我[uncle]做什么！？」

lines.en: scene ayanestreet8
: And I had to be all like, ‘Nothing!’ and-
lines.zh: : 然后我只好回她「没什么！」然后——

lines.en: scene ayanestreet10
: I’m a bad date, aren’t I?
lines.zh: : 我是个糟糕的约会对象，对吧？

lines.en: : What? No, that’s not it.
lines.zh: : 什么？不，不是那么回事。

lines.en: : I just don’t think I’m ready to talk about children and marriage and all that just yet...
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得，我还没准备好谈孩子、结婚这些事……

lines.en: : Is it...because you can't imagine a future with me?
lines.zh: : 是……因为你想不出和我的未来吗？

lines.en: : I think it's more that people are...you know...sexually involved with one another before the topic of kids comes up.
lines.zh: : 我觉得更像是……你知道的……在谈孩子之前，人们总要先有性关系。

lines.en: And also the fact that I can't imagine myself ever wanting {i}any{/i} children.
lines.zh: 还有就是，我实在想象不出自己会想要{i}任何{/i}孩子。

lines.en: : I mean...I guess that makes sense.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我想这倒说得通。

lines.en: : Sex is kind of required to make children, so yeah. I think it's safe to say it makes sense.
lines.zh: : 生孩子总归是需要性行为的，所以是啊。我觉得这么说确实成立。

lines.en: : Am I wrong for daydreaming, though?
lines.zh: : 可我做白日梦，是错的吗？

lines.en: : I wouldn't say {i}wrong...{/i}But I'd also maybe think a little harder before sharing some of those daydreams with people.
lines.zh: : 我倒不会说{i}错……{/i}不过在把这些白日梦说给别人听之前，也许你该多想一步。

lines.en: scene ayanestreet11
: Yeah...
: Yeah, I can...get ahead of myself at times. I know.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我有时候……是会把话说得太超前。我知道。

lines.en: : It's just a...unique challenge to have parts of your fantasy start to come true while the other parts are forced to sit on the sidelines and wait for their turn.
lines.zh: : 只是……幻想的一部分开始成真，而另一部分却只能坐在场边排队等着，这是一种很独特的煎熬。

lines.en: : I guess I'm just not great at dealing with that yet.
lines.zh: : 我想我只是还不太擅长应付这种事。

lines.en: : But I'll get better. For your sake {i}and{/i} my sake.
lines.zh: : 但我会变好的。为了你，{i}也{/i}为了我自己。

lines.en: : I don't want this to be some sort of...temporary thing, you know? I'm really serious about this, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我不想让这变成某种……暂时的事情，你知道吧？我真的很认真，Sensei。

lines.en: : You're-
lines.zh: : 你只是——

lines.en: : And before you go and say something like {i}You're just a teenager{/i} or {i}you have your whole life ahead of you{/i} I'd like an opportunity to counter.
lines.zh: : 而在你开口说{i}你只是个青少年{/i}或者{i}你的人生还长着呢{/i}之前，我想先有机会反驳。

lines.en: : It's not really a counter unless an opposing point has been made first.
lines.zh: : 那得先有人提出反对意见，你的话才算反驳。

lines.en: : Yeah, well I've prepared myself for any opposing point you can possibly come up with-
lines.zh: : 是吗，反正我已经为你可能想到的任何反对意见做好了准备——

lines.en: scene ayanestreet12
: And my counter is this...
lines.zh: : 而我的反驳是……

lines.en: Ayane stares deep into my eyes and I can tell that whatever she's about to say has had not months, but years of time poured into it.
lines.zh: Ayane 深深地凝视着我的眼睛，我看得出来，她接下来要说的话，倾注的不是几个月，而是好些年的心思。

lines.en: I can only imagine how hard it must be to incessantly agonize over whether or not your dreams are achievable.
lines.zh: 我只能想象，无休止地为自己的梦想能否实现而痛苦，该有多难熬。

lines.en: And with hers so close, yet so far away...
lines.zh: 而她的梦想近在咫尺，却又遥不可及……

lines.en: These words will have to move mountains.
lines.zh: 这些话必须能移山才行。

lines.en: But I am no normal mountain. I am-
lines.zh: 但我可不是普通的山。我是——

lines.en: : I want to wake up next to those sweatpants every day for the rest of my life.
lines.zh: : 我想余生每天醒来，身边都是那条运动裤。

lines.en: scene ayanestreet12r
: Hah...
: I had you concerned there, didn't I?
lines.zh: : 刚才把你吓到了吧？

lines.en: : To be totally honest, I {i}did{/i} have a really cute, really sweet thing I was going to say- but I figured that now probably isn't the time and, well, I'm still kind of regretting not being able to do karate with you today.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我{i}本来{/i}确实准备了一句非常可爱、非常甜蜜的话——不过我觉得现在大概不是时候，而且，我还是有点遗憾今天没能和你一起练空手道。

lines.en: : Well, you're definitely right. Now was most certainly not the time.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你说得一点没错。现在确实不是时候。

lines.en: : Save any huge bombshells about the future of our relationship for at least a few more not-dates. {i}Then{/i} you can consider dropping them on me.
lines.zh: : 关于我们关系未来的那些重磅炸弹，至少再留几场「不算约会」再说。{i}到那时{/i}你再考虑往我身上扔。

lines.en: : Sensei, I am going to drop so many bombshells on you that-
lines.zh: : Sensei，我到时候要往你身上扔好多好多的炸弹，多到——

lines.en: : I'm going to cut you off right there as I can't imagine {i}any{/i} possible way for that joke to not end extremely offensively.
lines.zh: : 我就在这儿打断你，因为我想不出{i}任何{/i}一种可能，能让这个笑话不以极度下流收场。

lines.en: scene ayanestreet13
: See, this is why I love you! You've been looking out for me for as long as we've known each other.
lines.zh: : 看吧，这就是我爱你的原因！从我们认识起，你就一直在护着我。

lines.en: : So if I can look out for you for even a fraction of that...it'll be everything I've ever wanted.
lines.zh: : 所以，哪怕我只能回报你其中的一星半点……那也是我想要的全部了。

lines.en: : Well, almost everything.
lines.zh: : 嗯，几乎是所有。

lines.en: : I have several fantasies I will require your assistance in living out, but I think they would be considered bombshells, so I'll keep them to myself for now.
lines.zh: : 我有几个幻想需要你协助我实现，不过我觉得它们也算重磅炸弹，所以暂时先藏在心里。

lines.en: : I mean...I'd be fine with you sharing {i}those{/i} ones if-
lines.zh: : 我是说……如果是{i}那些{/i}的话，你说说也无妨——

lines.en: : Nope. You made your bed and- now you have to put on your sexy sweatpants and lay in it.
lines.zh: : 不行。你自己铺的床——现在就得穿上你那条性感的运动裤躺上去。

lines.en: : Okay, this date is over now.
lines.zh: : 好了，这场约会到此结束。

lines.en: scene black
: Woo! Best date ever! I didn't even have to use my hand grenade!
lines.zh: : 呜呼！史上最棒的约会！我连手榴弹都没用上！

lines.en: : You don't have a grenade, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 你根本没有手榴弹，Ayane。

lines.en: : That's what you think, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 你以为的而已，Sensei！

lines.en: : Why do I feel like I understand less about you every time the two of us talk?
lines.zh: : 为什么我总觉得，我们每聊一次，我就更不了解你一点？

lines.en: Ayane and I leave the bench after another few minutes and make our way back to the dorms.
lines.zh: 又过了几分钟，我和 Ayane 离开长椅，往宿舍走去。

lines.en: She locks me in a bear hug for a good thirty seconds as she says goodbye and I go to pat her on the head, but have to stop myself as I don't think she's earned it quite yet.
lines.zh: 道别时，她把我紧紧熊抱了整整三十秒；我本想拍拍她的头，但还是忍住了，因为我觉得她还没到那个份上。

lines.en: Despite her mild insanity, though, she really is cute at times.
lines.zh: 不过，尽管她有点轻度疯狂，她有时候真的很可爱。

lines.en: That cuteness just normally vanishes whenever I'm reminded that her handbag is filled with things that could get us killed.
lines.zh: 只是每当我想起她的手提包里塞满了能要了我们命的东西，那份可爱通常就消失得无影无踪了。

$ dojo10 = True
{i}Ayane’s affection has increased to [ayane_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Ayane 的好感度提升到了 [ayane_love]!{/i}
